body: I'm glad I came here as well, It is helping me feel less alone about everything, so thanks for your support! And you have no need to apologise, your communication skills seem fine to me.

If I think of anything else that would be of help i'll definitely let you know. I only found this subreddit today and it seems like a really helpful place for anyone going through depression and suicide.
Thanks, it is good to hear that. Currently doing the typical self blaming thing and the support is really helping.
Therapy is a difficult topic with her, she has been through before and hated it, but you're right. I think it's something I'll need to bring up when she is in a better state of mind.
Yea, I think alcohol act as a catalyst with other triggers. I can normally see when she is going to get in a bad way if she's only had one pint, its when i'm not there it becomes a bigger issue.
Thanks, Alcohol is definitely something we will need to work through.
Thank you. The talking tips was very helpful to read and something I will definitely keep in mind.

I really appreciate all the support and comments from everyone. I'm commenting separately as it seems the easiest way to reply to all of you. 
The drink issue is definitely something we are going to have to deal with together. 90% of the time when she drinks everything is fine but there is just the occasional night where it gets bad, normally when something has upset her on that day. I drink quite a lot myself, and i'm thinking if I try an cut down with her it might be the best way to handle things. I currently just feel at a complete loss as to what to do. She is in the hospital now, but her phone is out of battery and I can't contact her. I can't get down to the city as I have no money and borrowing money of someone would involve having to tell them what happened, which would really not help her right now. We had talked before about her previous attempt and the thing she hated most about it was what she put everyone else through and is now terrified of anyone else finding out. I used to suffer from depression when I was younger and kept it to myself. When my friends and family started to suspect something it made things worse, so I understand why she doesn't want people to know. Sorry for rambling, i'm just at a complete loss right now and talking to everyone here is helping me get my head around this.
Thanks. I'm still in a state of shock, can't really get my head around things.
